summary: Perform synchronous renderer-to-main IPC and block until event.returnValue is set.

target.notes: Must block the calling renderer execution context until a reply is available and use Electron-compatible serialization.

caveats: Replacing sendSync with await invoke changes reentrancy and event-loop behavior.
This API can deadlock; do not hide that semantic risk in an async lowering.

tests.name: sync reply
tests.expected_behavior: renderer blocks until main supplies returnValue

tests.name: uncloneable payload
tests.expected_behavior: throws rather than transferring the function
